name: Nemessándorháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemessándorháza: a crowned oval quartered blue, red and black with a bird, a bunch of grapes, a patriarchal cross and a sabre, within a grey frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemessándorháza arms with crown and frame
